title: Claim received confirmation
description: Confirm that an insurance claim was received on WhatsApp, with claim number and expected review time. Reassuring utility template.
notes: Always include the claim number; it is the strongest signal that this is transactional. Set a realistic review time to cut follow-up chats.

body.text: Hello {{first_name}}, we received your claim *{{claim_no}}* on {{date}}. An adjuster will review it within {{days}} business days and contact you if we need more information.
